reviews.comment:
Ni 1 estrella se merecen,el día de hoy fui a comprar al shop y la atención recibida es pésima,malas caras,no te saludan ni saben decir Gracias o de nada...te atienden peor que un perro,al elegir la promoción de café,7mil pesos ,1cafe y 3 facturas nada barato...te quieren cobrar más caro x un vaso de cartón para llevar??? 2mil pesos más...no es x la plata es x la falta de educación recibida,de cuarta....

(Translated by Google)
They don't even deserve one star. Today I went to buy something at the shop and the service was terrible. They had bad attitudes, didn't greet me, and didn't even know how to say "thank you" or "you're welcome"... they treated me worse than a dog. When I chose the coffee promotion, it was 7,000 pesos for one coffee and three pastries—not cheap at all! And then they tried to charge me more for a cardboard cup to go? 2,000 pesos more! It's not about the money, it's about the lack of manners. It was awful.
